title_sw: Upungufu wa maji mwilini kwa mtoto
danger_signs_en: Very sleepy or hard to wake | Unable to drink or drinks poorly | Sunken eyes | Skin pinch goes back very slowly
danger_signs_sw: Amesinzia sana au ni vigumu kumwamsha | Hawezi kunywa au anakunywa kwa shida | Macho yamezama | Ngozi ikifinywa inarudi polepole sana
steps_en: Give oral rehydration solution in small sips | Keep breastfeeding | Refer to a clinician at once if any danger sign is present
steps_sw: Mpe ORS kwa mafunda madogo madogo | Endelea kumnyonyesha | Mpeleke kwa mhudumu wa afya mara moja kama kuna dalili yoyote ya hatari

danger_signs_en: Convulsions | Stiff neck | Unable to drink or breastfeed | Vomits everything
danger_signs_sw: Degedege | Shingo imekakamaa | Hawezi kunywa wala kunyonya | Anatapika kila kitu
steps_en: Measure the temperature | Test for malaria if a test is available | Give plenty of fluids | Refer if the fever lasts more than 2 days
steps_sw: Pima joto la mwili | Pima malaria kama kipimo kipo | Mpe maji mengi ya kunywa | Mpeleke kliniki kama homa itadumu zaidi ya siku 2

title_sw: Dalili za malaria kwa mtu mzima
danger_signs_en: Confusion or fainting | Yellow eyes | Dark urine or very little urine | Difficulty breathing
danger_signs_sw: Kuchanganyikiwa au kuzimia | Macho ya njano | Mkojo mweusi au mkojo kidogo sana | Kupumua kwa shida
steps_en: Test with a malaria rapid test | Record the result and the time | Refer a positive result to a clinician for treatment
steps_sw: Pima kwa kipimo cha haraka cha malaria | Andika majibu na muda | Mpeleke mwenye majibu chanya kwa mhudumu wa afya kwa matibabu

title_en: Cough or difficult breathing in a child
title_sw: Kikohozi au kupumua kwa shida kwa mtoto
danger_signs_en: Chest pulls in when breathing | Noisy breathing at rest | Lips or tongue look blue
danger_signs_sw: Kifua kinavutika ndani wakati wa kupumua | Anapumua kwa kelele akiwa amepumzika | Midomo au ulimi una rangi ya bluu
steps_en: Count the breaths for one full minute | Keep the child warm | Refer at once if any danger sign is present
steps_sw: Hesabu pumzi kwa dakika moja kamili | Mweke mtoto mahali penye joto | Mpeleke mara moja kama kuna dalili yoyote ya hatari

title_sw: Dalili za hatari wakati wa ujauzito
danger_signs_en: Bleeding from the vagina | Severe headache or blurred vision | Fits | The baby moves less or stops moving
danger_signs_sw: Kutoka damu ukeni | Maumivu makali ya kichwa au kuona giza | Degedege | Mtoto tumboni anacheza kidogo au ameacha kucheza
steps_en: Help her lie on her left side | Arrange transport to a health facility now | Send her clinic card with her
steps_sw: Msaidie alale kwa upande wa kushoto | Panga usafiri kwenda kituo cha afya sasa hivi | Mpe kadi yake ya kliniki aende nayo

title_sw: Dalili za hatari kwa mtoto mchanga
danger_signs_en: Not feeding well | Fever or a cold body | Fast breathing | Yellow palms or soles
danger_signs_sw: Hanyonyi vizuri | Homa au mwili wa baridi | Anapumua haraka | Viganja au nyayo za njano
steps_en: Keep the baby warm, skin to skin | Keep breastfeeding often | Refer to a health facility the same day
steps_sw: Mweke mtoto kwenye joto, ngozi kwa ngozi | Endelea kumnyonyesha mara kwa mara | Mpeleke kituo cha afya siku hiyo hiyo

danger_signs_en: Swelling of both feet | Arm tape reading in the red zone | Very thin and weak
danger_signs_sw: Miguu yote miwili imevimba | Utepe wa kupima mkono uko kwenye rangi nyekundu | Amekonda sana na ni dhaifu
steps_en: Measure the arm circumference | Weigh the child | Refer to the nutrition programme
steps_sw: Pima mzunguko wa mkono | Pima uzito wa mtoto | Mpeleke kwenye mpango wa lishe

danger_signs_en: Bleeding that does not stop with pressure | Redness spreading around the wound | Pus or a bad smell | Fever
danger_signs_sw: Damu isiyokoma hata ukibonyeza | Wekundu unaosambaa kuzunguka kidonda | Usaha au harufu mbaya | Homa
steps_en: Wash your hands | Clean the wound with clean water | Cover it with a clean dressing | Ask about tetanus vaccination
steps_sw: Nawa mikono | Safisha kidonda kwa maji safi | Funika kwa bandeji safi | Uliza kuhusu chanjo ya pepopunda

danger_signs_en: Burn on the face, hands or genitals | Burn larger than the patient's palm | Difficulty breathing after smoke
danger_signs_sw: Kuungua usoni, mikononi au sehemu za siri | Jeraha kubwa kuliko kiganja cha mgonjwa | Kupumua kwa shida baada ya moshi
steps_en: Cool the burn with clean running water for 20 minutes | Do not apply butter, oil or toothpaste | Cover loosely with a clean cloth
steps_sw: Poza jeraha kwa maji safi yanayotiririka kwa dakika 20 | Usipake siagi, mafuta wala dawa ya meno | Funika kwa kitambaa safi bila kubana

danger_signs_en: Blood in the stool | Cannot keep any fluids down | Very weak or confused
danger_signs_sw: Damu kwenye kinyesi | Anatapika kila anachokunywa | Dhaifu sana au amechanganyikiwa
steps_en: Give oral rehydration solution after every loose stool | Keep eating light food | Refer if the diarrhoea lasts more than 3 days
steps_sw: Mpe ORS kila baada ya kuharisha | Aendelee kula chakula chepesi | Mpeleke kliniki kama kuharisha kutadumu zaidi ya siku 3
